**INSUFFICIENT_DATA**

No meaningful promotional activity (paid or organic) was found in the last 14 days for dedicated products turning coding-agent output into shareable pages/team-reviewable docs. 

- **Showly**: Only one account (@engineer_num1) posted a series of tutorial threads (e.g., “【小学生でもわかるShowly 第8話】” explaining multi-agent connections, permissions, password-protected drafts, version handling, and sharing). Low engagement (0–2 likes). Organic/educational tone, not promotional. No other promoters or sales posts.[[1]](https://x.com/engineer_num1/status/2110707298637386035)
- **Velven**: Zero results.
- **Claude Artifacts publishing / sharing**: Scattered organic discussion posts (e.g., @armannadjafi on collaborative commenting, @rickye26 on local review tools, @Greg_TheBuilder on collection shelves). No product launches, dedicated promoters, or marketing messages. Low engagement.
- **Codex share, Vercel previews, v0/Lovable/Bolt sharing**: Only incidental mentions in unrelated contexts (e.g., Vercel previews in agent workflows, Lovable build previews). No targeted promotions matching the query criteria.

No posts addressed the specific gaps noted (team ownership, agent-neutrality, feedback loops to agents, persistent URLs across versions) in a promotional context.
